subject: infra.connect

subject: infra.store

subject: dpi.id

subject: dpi.registry

subject: dpi.govtech

subject: dpi.pay

subject: data.statistics

subject: gov.protect

subject: gov.protect

what_would_settle_it: A regulator notice or procurement record establishing when the system was introduced, its legal basis and its data-handling terms; the base has only a newspaper year-review reporting its introduction in 2025

subject: gov.standards

what_would_settle_it: The regional regulators' association publication of the Declaration, unpublished at 2026-08-05, so a named-analyst commentary is the whole of the wiki's account and the seven action areas are nowhere enumerated

subject: gov.regional

what_would_settle_it: An instrument of ratification for the AU Malabo Convention, or a Malawian instrument transposing the AU Data Policy Framework or a regional model law; the base records only that the Data Protection Act aligns closely with the continental framework, in a third-party legal review

subject: finance.budget

what_would_settle_it: The 2025/26 and 2026/27 Approved Estimates of Expenditure on Recurrent and Capital Budget, or the Budget Statement itself; there is no domestic budget archive for Malawi, so every appropriation figure held is a journalist's or minister's reading

subject: finance.budget

subject: gov.policy
